newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares off 5% in long-overdue correction.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares off 5% in long-overdue correction.

text.p: Slovenian shares tumbled 5.68 percent on Wednesday on what traders said was natural profit-taking after recent sharp and rapid gains.
Today's fall seen as long-overdue correction, and with sentiment still buoyant, market seen headed for long-term growth.

"This was just a correction, which should not last too long -- growth has just begun and I expect prices to continue rising over the next six months supported by foreign buying," Franci Zmavc, a trader at brokerage Intara said.
* The SBI index fell 92.15 points to 1,530.6.
* Bank SKB was the most active, falling 2.08 percent to 58,750 tolars on volume 2,547 shares.
* Overall 13 shares fell, six rose and six were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
